title: Drowned Reef
wikitext:
[[Image:DrownedReef.jpg|thumb|Ships sunken on the Drowned Reef]]

A dangerous and mysterious reef on the southern shores of [[Arathi Highlands]]. 

The dangers of the reef are many, and many a ship found its last harbour there, including ''Maiden's Folly'' and ''Spirit of Silverpine''. Under the waters of the bay lies a ruined, sunken, ancient Night Elven temple, now inhabited by the [[Naga|Nagas]] of the [[Daggerspine]] tribe, led by [[Prince Nazjak]].

The Daggerspines seem to be able to control the tides of the bay, dooming many hapless crews trying to find refuge in [[Faldir's Cove]].
